title: Kapwing Pricing 2026: Plans, Credits & Costs Explained
summary: Kapwing pricing tiers are broken down by feature limits and credit allocations to help you choose the right subscription for your video production needs.
body_markdown:
## Kapwing pricing and plan structures for 2026


### Kapwing free plan features and limits


The Free plan is a persistent trial environment where you can test the timeline interface and basic trimming tools without an upfront commitment. Because every export on this tier carries a permanent watermark, these files aren't suitable for professional portfolios or monetized social channels.


You're further restricted by a maximum export length that prevents the production of long-form content. You also face a resolution cap that limits the visual fidelity of your final render.


This tier is best utilized for prototyping or creating internal drafts before you migrate to a paid subscription for clean, high-resolution delivery.


### The Pro plan: the standard for individual creators


The Pro plan removes the watermark and increases the resource ceiling for solo editors who need consistent access to 4K exports and longer timelines. By paying a fixed rate, you unlock a monthly allocation of AI credits.


Per-seat pricing rations automation. Consumption pricing doesn't. While many creative suites charge for every new editor added to the workspace, Activepieces meters by consumption rather than headcount.


On the Activepieces pricing page, the credit-based structure allows for unlimited flows on every plan, meaning a studio can add as many collaborators as needed without increasing the base subscription cost until they actually execute a run.


### What is a Kapwing automation workflow


In the context of modern automation, a flow is a sequence of automated tasks that connects different software applications to perform work without manual intervention. For a video creator, a flow might automatically move a finished render from a cloud editor to a social media scheduler. By offering these sequences without a per-unit cap, the platform allows users to build complex logic chains that handle file management and notifications in the background.


This model ensures that scaling a team doesn't create a financial backlog, a fact utilized by companies like Alan and Funding Societies to run production automation without seat-based penalties.

The Pro plan satisfies the resolution needs of most creators, but the hard cap on monthly credits can still stall your production during high-volume weeks.


### Kapwing Business plan features and pricing


The Business plan targets small agencies and internal marketing teams that require collaborative workspaces and a significantly higher credit pool for bulk processing. This tier gives you the highest priority for cloud rendering.


Priority rendering reduces the time you spend waiting for a file to process. It allows for longer video durations to support the creation of webinars or instructional series that would exceed the Pro plan’s limits.


If you're managing multiple brands, this level of access is the only way to centralize assets and billing under a single administrative seat.
